units: Lore meters; one Blender unit equals one meter
pivot: Root at (0,0,0); root is neutral and never translated by a clip. Body bind height approximately0.32m. Controller owns world position and flight altitude. Pivot is not a foot contact point.
altitude: For flight, add controller altitude to root. ShadowAnchor remains root local (0,0,0); consumer projects ground shadow independently. Do not add keyed vertical translation.
groundContact: No standing/walking/landing-contact clip. Land_Ready is an approach/tuck pose, not grounded contact, and must transition under controller placement.
hex: Base creature is friendly. Violet binding/hex shell is a separate consumer effect at BodyHex. Freed requests hex removal and escape rather than death. No binding meshes in any tier.

Idle_Glide.purpose: Small living sail/body and tail corrections

Flap.purpose: Synchronized shoulder/hip sail flex with wrist followthrough and tail rudder

Bank.purpose: Visible in-place roll and yaw, asymmetric shoulders with counter rudder

Dive_Attack.purpose: Pitch down, sweep forelimbs, release wind at0.70s from AttackRelease

Hit_Recover.purpose: Short backward recoil, open sail, return to glide

Freed.purpose: Relieved lift and two vigorous sail beats, consumer clears hex and moves creature away

Land_Ready.purpose: Symmetric lowering/tucking approach posture; no floor contact claim

sockets.AttackRelease: Actual empty bone-parented to Head at mouth; consumer uses asset forward +Z
sockets.BodyHex: Actual Body bone-parent node, removable external binding
sockets.ShadowAnchor: Actual Root bone-parent node; projected ground position

skin: One skinned mesh and one opaque rough vertex-color material per tier, four normalized bone weights maximum; no alpha or morph dependence. All runtime tiers share skeleton and animations.
